0022600031.text: The Pelicans (3-4, 11th in the West) host the Timberwolves (5-3, 8th in the West) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group B game, with New Orleans on a three-game winning streak and Minnesota on a one-game streak. Trey Murphy III (knee) and Yves Missi (knee bruise) are out for New Orleans, while Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Pelicans lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 132-126 defeat in Minneapolis on April 12, 2026.
